newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia arrests alleged killers of Belgium's Cools.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia arrests alleged killers of Belgium's Cools.

text.p: Tunisian authorities have arrested two Tunisian men suspected of murdering leading Belgian politician Andre Cools in 1991, official and diplomatic sources said on Thursday.
Tunisian Justice Minister Sadok Chaabane met Belgium Ambassador Daniel Leroy to inform him of the arrests, a Belgian diplomat told Reuters.

The two suspects, identified as Abdelmajid el-Almi and Abdeljelil Ben Brahim, confessed to Tunisian investigators they had carried out a contract killing on Cools, a source close to the investigation said.
"They confessed having received a contract killing from an European when they were living in Europe," the source said.

Official sources said Tunisian police last month opened a probe to find the two suspects after receiving reports from Belgium over their alleged involvement. The two suspects have been questioned by an investigating magistrate to the Tunis court since the beginning of this week.
Cools, a former Socialist minister, was shot at point-blank range in the car park outside his mistress's appartment near the eastern Belgian city of Liege, on July 18, 1991.
Six people, including former government minister Alain Van der Biest, have been arrested and charged with orchestrating Cool's murder. Van der Biest denies any involvment in the killing.
